ns2:section.sectionText: ### An introduction to the craft of writing and submitting successful grant applications. Grant writing is critical for multi-type libraries, nonprofit information entities, and other service-based organizations. Through a combination of individual and group assignments, and peer and instructor review, students will learn how to identify grant sources and strategically target their writing to those sources.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
